mapper.insert: INSERT INTO place_social_videos ( id, place_id, social_job_id, source_url, canonical_url, platform, title, thumbnail_url, creator_name, video_summary, video_useful_summary, general_guidance, place_recap, useful_info, visit_guidance, evidence_sources, evidence_text, confidence, language, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{placeId}, #{socialJobId}, #{sourceUrl}, #{canonicalUrl}, #{platform}, #{title}, #{thumbnailUrl}, #{creatorName}, #{videoSummary}, #{videoUsefulSummary}, CAST(#{generalGuidance,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{placeRecap}, CAST(#{usefulInfo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), CAST(#{visitGuidance,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), CAST(#{evidenceSources,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), CAST(#{evidenceText,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{confidence}, #{language}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (place_id, social_job_id) DO UPDATE SET source_url = EXCLUDED.source_url, canonical_url = EXCLUDED.canonical_url, platform = EXCLUDED.platform, title = EXCLUDED.title, thumbnail_url = EXCLUDED.thumbnail_url, creator_name = EXCLUDED.creator_name, video_summary = EXCLUDED.video_summary, video_useful_summary = EXCLUDED.video_useful_summary, general_guidance = EXCLUDED.general_guidance, place_recap = EXCLUDED.place_recap, useful_info = EXCLUDED.useful_info, visit_guidance = EXCLUDED.visit_guidance, evidence_sources = EXCLUDED.evidence_sources, evidence_text = EXCLUDED.evidence_text, confidence = EXCLUDED.confidence, language = EXCLUDED.language, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM place_social_videos WHERE place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, created_at DESC
